statements.statement: The patient presents with recurrent episodes of unexplained syncope and near-syncope
There is concern for intermittent arrhythmia
The patient has a personal history of transient ischemic attack and cerebral infarction
Prolonged mobile cardiac telemetry is ordered to correlate symptoms with potential cardiac rhythm disturbances
Diagnosis codes R55 and Z86.73 were submitted
The denial reason code is CO-197
The denial is based on lack of required precertification or prior authorization
